sentences.text: For Petitioner : Mr.P.Balamurugan  For R1, R2 : Mr.N.Muthu Vijayan  Special Government Pleader  ORDER The petitioner seeks a direction in the nature of mandamus against the first and second respondents to pay compensation amount, relating to the acquisition of property at S.No. 435/2 measuring an extent of Hectares 1.19.8 ares at Thirumalai Naicken Pudukudi village, within the Puliyankudi Municipal limit, Tenkasi District, which was acquired by way of notification, dated 21.05.2021 as per Section 3(A)(1) of National Highways Act, 1956.

2.The petitioner and the respondents 3 to 6 are interlocked with three separate Civil suits in O.S.No.80 of 1989, O.S.No.192 of 1999 and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis O.S.No.96 of 1992,
which are all pending before the District Munsif Court, Sankarankovil.
There is also dispute with respect to division of compensation to be paid for acquisition of lands.
A representation in this regard had been given to the second respondent.

3.A direction is given to the second respondent to take note of pendency of all the suits, issue notices to the petitioner and to the respondents 3 to 6 and if there is any dispute in disbursing the compensation amount, deposit the amount, where the suits are already pending and that Court shall decide the division of compensation amount among the parties.
Such a decision should be taken by the second respondent, within a period of eight weeks, from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4.With the above direction, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
